pbi-dashboard.title: Executive Power BI Analytics Dashboard
pbi-dashboard.tag: 🍃 2026 Season Horizon • Live BI District Engine
pbi-dashboard.desc: District-wide harvest targets, green leaf intake, outturn efficiency, and multi-tier auction price discovery models across Dibrugarh's corporate and smallholder sectors.
pbi-dashboard.secH2: Dibrugarh District Harvest & Trade Analytics (2026 Operational Horizon)
pbi-dashboard.secLead: Interactive Power BI dashboard synthesizing green leaf intake, factory made-tea conversion ratios, auction price realizations, and operational agricultural units across Dibrugarh district.

map-section.title: Satellite GIS Terrain & Heritage Estates
map-section.desc: True-color satellite survey mapping tea plantations, Brahmaputra alluvial corridors, revenue circles, and 10 landmark heritage estates with verified coordinates.
map-section.secH2: Heritage Estate Coordinates Map of Dibrugarh, Assam
map-section.secLead: Interactive geographic map of Dibrugarh district showing the Brahmaputra River course and spatial distribution of landmark corporate tea estates across its 5 revenue circles.

estates-177.title: 177 Corporate Tea Estates Census
estates-177.desc: Comprehensive macro census of Dibrugarh's 177 corporate tea estates, covering 58,168 ha geographical grant, 37,254 ha under cultivation, and 121,671 workers.
estates-177.secLead: Exhaustive field audit across all 177 organized plantation companies in Dibrugarh. Visualizing land grant utilization, factory workforce distribution, and annual wage bill economics.

stg-analytics.title: Small Tea Growers (STG) Ecosystem
stg-analytics.desc: Official Tea Board of India verified small tea growers directory for Borboruah block, tracking 22,283 hectares of smallholder plantations and multi-year harvest yields.
stg-analytics.secH2: Small Tea Growers Landscape (Borboruah Block & District-Wide)
stg-analytics.secLead: Granular verification of smallholder tea cultivation. Analyzing field survey records from Borboruah Block alongside district-level growth trajectories and Bought-Leaf Factory price linkages.

scrolly-journey.title: The Tea Journey — Agronomy & Processing
scrolly-journey.desc: Step-by-step visual exploration of Upper Assam tea cultivation: nursery propagation, fine two-leaves-and-a-bud plucking, withering lofts, orthodox rolling, and CTC fermentation.
scrolly-journey.secH2: The Agronomic & Manufacturing Journey of Dibrugarh Tea
scrolly-journey.secLead: Follow the transformation of Camellia sinensis var. assamica across 7 master stages from deep alluvial nursery soil to international tasting cups.

auctions.title: Commercial Auctions & GTAC Realization
auctions.desc: Real-time trading analytics, price spreads between Orthodox and CTC grades, and multi-year auction volume trends at the Guwahati Tea Auction Centre (GTAC).
auctions.secH2: Guwahati Tea Auction Centre (GTAC) Price Discovery
auctions.secLead: Auction analytics documenting weekly price trends, grade differentials between Orthodox golden tips and CTC dust, and institutional buyer bidding dynamics.

exports.title: Global Tea Exports & Trade Geography
exports.desc: Destination country breakdown, port throughput (Kolkata, Haldia, JNPT), and FOB export realizations across major global buyers including Iraq, UAE, Russia, and Germany.
exports.secLead: Tracking Dibrugarh's export volume across major continental markets with FOB price realizations, ocean freight lanes, and port clearances.

domestic.title: Interstate Trade & Seasonal Harvest Rhythm
domestic.desc: Interstate tea dispatches across top consuming states (Maharashtra, UP, Gujarat), seasonal 4-flush volume distribution, and bought-leaf factory pricing.
domestic.secH2: Pan-India Interstate Movement & Flush Harvest Rhythm
domestic.secLead: Mapping domestic consumption hubs and the dramatic production surges between first, second, monsoon, and autumnal harvest flushes.

records.title: Historical Production Time-Series Registry
records.desc: Multi-year production registry from 2022 to the 2026 Horizon, documenting area under cultivation, green leaf volume, made tea output, and yield per hectare.
records.secLead: Historical statistical time-series documenting the progression of Dibrugarh's tea economy across key agricultural and economic indicators.
